scope: Independent assistant review of the fresh 150-row sample from the final 10000-output catalog. No output was repaired or regenerated.
criteria: Accept grammatical ordinary short utterances and explicit story personification; mark unclear or unusual wording as questionable; reject clear malformed constructions or wording without a clear ordinary reading.
limitations: This is subjective assistant review, not a human linguistic evaluation or correctness proof.
Questionable entries are not automatically ungrammatical.
The catalog demonstrates distinct generated word sequences, not that those strings were absent from training data.
No claim that all arbitrary seeds produce complete, unique, or good sentences.
